title: How to Hold a Phone Without It Holding You
caption:
Ease is the whole trap. It's one tap away because someone got paid to make it that way.

A godly man notices who's actually driving his morning, builds a little friction on purpose, and asks what the hour on his phone is replacing. It's not that the phone is evil, it's that it's greedy. It takes every minute you don't specifically protect from it.

"Be transformed by the renewing of your mind." Romans 12:2

Let a few minutes stay empty. That's where most of the good stuff used to happen.
